arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
translationEn: Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear.
reflection: Whatever you face today, it has been measured for your strength. Take the next small step.

arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translationEn: Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
reflection: Difficulty and ease arrive together. Patience reveals what struggle conceals.

arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
translationEn: And whoever relies upon Allah — then He is sufficient for him.
reflection: Do your part with sincerity, then release the outcome.

arabic: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
translationEn: Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
reflection: When the mind is loud, return to remembrance. Stillness follows.

arabic: الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَاةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا
translationEn: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed.
reflection: Excellence over quantity. Choose the next action with care.

arabic: وَاصْبِرُوا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ
translationEn: And be patient. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
reflection: Patience is not silence. It is steady action without despair.

arabic: فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ
translationEn: And when you have decided, then rely upon Allah.
reflection: Decide. Commit. Trust the path you walked toward with intention.

arabic: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ
translationEn: So remember Me; I will remember you.
reflection: Turn your attention toward Him for a moment, and you are not forgotten.

arabic: لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
translationEn: Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
reflection: No matter how far the drift, the door of return is always open.

arabic: لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ
translationEn: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor].
reflection: Gratitude is not just a feeling — it is the soil in which more is grown.

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ
translationEn: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
reflection: When overwhelmed, do two things: pause to pray, and refuse to give up.

arabic: رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
translationEn: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
reflection: A short prayer for a lifelong posture: remain a student.

arabic: رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ
translationEn: My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit.
reflection: Beginnings and endings both deserve sincerity. Ask for both.

arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
translationEn: Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes, and make us a leader for the righteous.
reflection: Pray for the people in your home — your peace begins there.

arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
translationEn: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
reflection: The first step away from sin is naming it honestly before the One who can wash it.

arabic: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
translationEn: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
reflection: The supplication of Yunus inside the whale. No darkness is beyond rescue.

arabic: وَمَا تَوْفِيقِي إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ ۚ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ
translationEn: And my success is not but through Allah. Upon Him I have relied, and to Him I return.
reflection: Effort is yours; success is His to grant. Work hard, then rest the heart.

arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ
translationEn: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course — the angels will descend upon them.
reflection: Faith is a sentence; steadfastness is a lifetime. Stay the course.

arabic: قُل لَّن يُصِيبَنَا إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَنَا هُوَ مَوْلَانَا
translationEn: Say, 'Never will we be struck except by what Allah has decreed for us; He is our protector.'
reflection: What reaches you was meant for you; what missed you was never yours.

arabic: وَاسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ
translationEn: And seek help through patience and prayer.
reflection: Two anchors for any storm: don't quit, and keep praying.

arabic: فَفِرُّوا إِلَى اللَّهِ
translationEn: So flee to Allah.
reflection: From every burden, run toward — not away. The destination is the same shelter.

arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translationEn: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself.
reflection: Success is not what you accumulate. It is what you remove from the heart.

arabic: إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لَفِي خُسْرٍ ۝ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ
translationEn: Indeed, mankind is in loss, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds.
reflection: Time is the currency. Spend it on what survives the day.

arabic: مَن جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا
translationEn: Whoever comes [on the Day of Judgement] with a good deed will have ten times the like thereof.
reflection: Small good is never small. Multiplication is His mercy.

arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
translationEn: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.
reflection: The prayer of Musa in exile. Confess your need before you ask.

arabic: وَمَا بِكُم مِّن نِّعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ اللَّهِ
translationEn: And whatever you have of favor — it is from Allah.
reflection: Trace each blessing back to its Source. The view changes you.

arabic: وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا
translationEn: And those who strive for Us — We will surely guide them to Our ways.
reflection: Take the first step toward Him. The path opens to those who walk.

arabic: وَمَن يُؤْمِن بِاللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُ
translationEn: And whoever believes in Allah — He will guide his heart.
reflection: Faith is the lamp; the heart is the room. He lights it from within.

arabic: رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ
translationEn: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils.
reflection: Guard the doorway of your thoughts. The first whisper is where battles are won.

arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
translationEn: Our Lord, give us in this world good and in the Hereafter good, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
reflection: The most balanced prayer in the Book. Ask for both worlds — He gives generously.
